mapper.sql: s.story_id, s.author_id, s.title, s.intro, s.category, s.cover_url, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.audit_user_id, s.audit_time, s.publish_time, s.play_count, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.nickname AS author_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM story s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON s.author_id = u.user_id WHERE s.story_id = #{storyId}
SELECT FROM story s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON s.author_id = u.user_id WHERE s.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY s.update_time DESC
SELECT FROM story s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON s.author_id = u.user_id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story (author_id, title, intro, category, cover_url, status) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{category}, #{coverUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE story SET title=#{title}, intro=#{intro}, category=#{category}, cover_url=#{coverUrl} WHERE story_id=#{storyId}
UPDATE story SET status=#{status} WHERE story_id=#{storyId}
